items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And Koko(?), he was playing the bass... And every intermission, Koko would say, 'Come on, Lu, let's take a rest.' And we would eat, you know.

ctx.x: The trumpet player, right. And he laughed! And we could get all we wanted to eat... And Koko(?), he was playing the bass...
